_about: Regression set for /v1/validate. Two kinds of case: 'audited' ones were checked by a human reading the papers (they encode judgements, and a failure is a real regression), 'snapshot' ones only freeze today's behaviour so a refactor cannot silently change it. Never promote a snapshot case to audited without someone reading the paper.
